# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

module load pytorch/1.6.0-anaconda3-cuda10.2

pip install --no-index --upgrade pip

conda install -c akode atari-py

python Type_1.py
'
"
}
